items.title: Models bigger than your graphics card run
items.text: A model that needs more than the card's memory now runs with as much of it on the card as fits and the rest in the computer's memory, where it used to stop while loading. A mixture-of-experts model keeps its experts in memory first. Its GPU status says how much is on the card.

items.title: A bigger context window where it fits
items.text: Each model reads as much at once as fits your computer well: 8K, 16K, or 32K tokens, so a small model on a computer with plenty of memory reads about four times as much. Choose a size per model, up to what it was made for, and an API request that needs more gets it when it fits.

items.title: Answers that guess ahead
items.text: Toskar guesses the next words from the chat and checks several at once, so answers that repeat or edit your text come faster. The largest models bring a small draft model that writes ahead, for answers up to about twice as fast, just as good.

items.title: Follow-ups start sooner
items.text: A chat's next turn reuses the work the model already did on the conversation, so it starts answering sooner, and a new chat reuses what every chat shares. Diagnostics shows how much each turn reused.

items.title: Orders hidden in pages are left out
items.text: Text on a web page, in a file, in your knowledge, or in a tool's result that tells the AI what to do is removed before the model reads it, including forged chat turns written in a model's own markers.

items.title: The fastest computer answers
items.text: With computers connected, a chat goes to the one expected to answer soonest. Toskar learns how fast each reads and writes with each model, and counts the work already running on it.
